_comment: Editor layout for the Enderlein Gauss-Lorentz MDF FCS model (MdfFCSModel). Relocated out of gui/widgets, R0 renamed to wem (registry collision with FRET's Foerster-radius R0), regrouped into table-view parameter groups, added optional bunching terms.

sections.title: Equation

sections.description: The compound fitting equation currently active, including any bunching terms.
The correlation equation currently active (diffusion, triplet / bunching terms), or the catalogue / typed Python equation for a user-defined model.

sections.title: Physical
sections.description: Physical parameters of the diffusing species (diffusion time or D, number of molecules).

sections.title: Bunching terms
sections.description: Photophysical bunching terms (triplet, blinking): amplitude and relaxation time (us) each.

sections.title: Optics
sections.description: Beam waist and sample temperature convert a diffusion time into a hydrodynamic radius (Stokes-Einstein with the viscosity of water).

sections.title: Outputs
sections.description: Read-only derived quantities of the fit: effective volume, concentration and diffusion coefficient.
